cohort: Nulliparous women who gave birth at the National Maternity Hospital over two years (2014/2015)
finding: Only 0.8% of nulliparous mothers had a practically perfect birth, defined as labour without intervention, an intact perineum and a positive neonatal outcome.
mod_finding: Only 0.8% of nulliparous women experienced a "practically perfect" birth, defined as a labor without intervention, an intact perineum, and a positive neonatal outcome.
